# Panos Kokmotos

> Co-Founder & COO of Givelink, an in-kind donation platform. Forbes 30 Under 30 Greece (2024) and World Economic Forum Global Shaper (San Francisco). Builds technology for social impact; based between San Francisco and Athens.

## About
- **Full name:** Panagiotis ("Panos") Kokmotos
- **Role:** Co-Founder & COO of Givelink
- **Recognition:** Forbes 30 Under 30 Greece (2024); WEF Global Shaper, San Francisco Hub
- **Based in:** San Francisco, California, USA and Athens, Greece
- **Languages:** Greek, English, French, Spanish
- **Expertise:** entrepreneurship, social impact, in-kind donations, startup fundraising, AI & technology, product management, public speaking

## Givelink
Givelink is an in-kind donation platform and mobile app that lets donors shop for the exact goods nonprofits need most, with step-by-step tracking and photo confirmation. Founded in 2022 in Athens and live in the US since September 2025; 150+ nonprofit partners in Greece and the US, 8,900+ donations and 100,000+ products delivered, 130,000+ people helped. Raised a €450K pre-seed, including LATSCO Family Office and V Group.

## Also
- Runs Givelink as an AI-native company: AI agents and scheduled automations handle CRM sync, nonprofit scoring, catalog checks, invoicing and outreach drafts, with a person approving anything sent.
- Recognition: Forbes 30 Under 30 Greece, WEF Global Shaper (San Francisco Hub), Top 4 in Europe at the Global Student Entrepreneur Awards 2023, 19 awards in total (https://panoskokmotos.com/press.html).
- Works with startups on AI operations and US go-to-market: https://panoskokmotos.com/work.html
- Co-founder and host of **Entrepreneurship Talks**, a podcast with founders, investors, and changemakers (350K+ views, 60+ episodes).

## Open source
- **ZecHub** (Zcash education hub): led the Greek translation of zechub.wiki (https://zechub.wiki/el) and wrote its nonprofit donation guides: accepting private ZEC donations as a US nonprofit, where to donate ZEC, claiming a US tax deduction, and running a ZEC fundraising campaign. Also rewrote the Development Fund and Governance pages. Merged PRs: https://github.com/ZecHub/zechub/pulls?q=is%3Apr+author%3Apanoskokmotos+is%3Amerged
